name: ribbon
description: A slim band above the prompt: how much of your 5-hour and 7-day usage is left, when each resets, whether the prompt cache is warm or cold with what the next message costs, and how close the context is to auto-compaction, with a button that asks the agent whether to compact.

usage.title: Usage figure
usage.description: left shows how much of each window (and of the context) is left; used shows how much is spent

language.title: Language
language.description: en writes the band and the cache card in English; zh in Simplified Chinese (简体中文); zh-TW in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)

cardText.title: Card text size
cardText.description: how large the cache card's labels, captions and model names are: small as drawn upstream, medium 2 px larger, large 3 px larger

stackGap.title: Gap under other bands
stackGap.description: the space between another mod's band above (next-steps, say) and ribbon: none as upstream, sm a small step (no row in the terminal), md a larger one (one row in the terminal)
